// about: Config for the LuckyEngine C# -> Markdown API doc generator. Source path is resolved at runtime: --source CLI arg > LUCKYENGINE_SCRIPTCORE env var > first existing entry in sourceRootCandidates.

categories.title: Scene & Entities
categories.summary: The scene graph: entities, their lifecycle, and scene-level queries. This is where scripting begins. Most scripts derive from `Entity`.

categories.title: Components
categories.summary: Data and behavior attached to entities (transforms, meshes, lights, cameras, rigid bodies, audio, and more). Retrieved with `GetComponent<T>()`.

categories.title: Math
categories.summary: Vectors, quaternions, matrices, and math helpers for transforms, interpolation, and randomness.

categories.title: Physics
categories.summary: 3D and 2D physics queries, ray casts, colliders, materials, and force application.

categories.title: Rendering
categories.summary: Meshes, materials, textures, colors, and the debug/immediate-mode renderer.

categories.title: Audio
categories.summary: Play, control, and position sounds in the scene.

categories.title: Core & Input
categories.summary: Engine fundamentals scripts use every frame: input, logging, timing, application state, and assets.

categories.title: Editor Attributes
categories.summary: Attributes that control how a script's public fields appear and behave in the editor Inspector (sliders, ranges, tooltips, grouping, conditional visibility).

categories.title: Robots & Learning (MDP)
categories.summary: APIs for authoring robot agents and reinforcement-learning tasks: the MDP component model (observations, rewards, terminations, randomization), robot controllers, and agent management.
